# Turbot Pipes

Turbot Pipes is an intelligence, automation, and security platform built specifically for DevOps, offering hosted Steampipe database instances, shared dashboards, snapshots, and more.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/turbot-pipes/.

## Actions

- **Delete User Token**: Delete a specific user token.
- **Get Authenticated Actor** (read-only): Retrieve the authenticated actor.
- **Get Identity** (read-only): Retrieve a specific identity by handle.
- **Get Identity Avatar** (read-only): Retrieve avatar image for an identity.
- **Get User Token** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific user token.
- **List Actor Activity** (read-only): List activities for the authenticated actor.
- **List actor connections** (read-only): List connections associated with the authenticated actor.
- **List Actor Organizations** (read-only): List organizations associated with the authenticated actor.
- **List Actor Workspaces** (read-only): List workspaces for the authenticated actor.
- **List Identities** (read-only): List all identities.
- **List User Notifiers** (read-only): List all notifiers for a user.
- **Start login via Email**: Start login process by sending a confirmation code to a user's email.
